name: Telegram Restricted Content Bot
description: Private Telegram text and media delivery with channel joining and approval waits.

TELEGRAM_API_ID.description: Your Telegram application API ID from my.telegram.org/apps.

TELEGRAM_API_HASH.description: Your Telegram application API hash. Enter it privately here, never in GitHub.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Your bot token from BotFather. Keep this value private.

ALLOWED_USER_IDS.description: Comma-separated numeric Telegram user IDs allowed to use the bot.

TELEGRAM_SESSION.description: Contents of data/telegram-session.txt created by the local export-session command. Keep this account credential private.
